# Security verdict - PR 287

Result: PASS WITH NOTES for requested head
`8653a193a26a364083443f5648e292d1c471205c`, base
`a89e8cb64452ab92524bd41b93b9c74a7428c868`.

SUPERSEDED HEAD: the prepublication freeze found the PR at
`6855617c30767c52bc71d4bafbe4533572a0c941`, with CI still running. This verdict
answers the original request only. It is not a review or approval of the new
head.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 1 | ⚪ LOW | .omp/extensions/pij/core/generation-routing.ts | 134, 148, 162-169 | Terminal-control passthrough in human warning text; accepted trusted-local C33 residual, non-blocking | 9/10 |

No blocking, in-scope vulnerability was established. All five changed files were
reviewed. No added secrets, private owner identities, or machine-home paths were
found under C19/C21.

## Confirmed limitation and reachability

State control lines and send receipt warnings are printed verbatim. The
daemon's warning producer at `crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:2996-3010` calls
`shell_word`: this quotes shell syntax but preserves terminal controls.
A builtin-only probe of the exact TS renderer bodies confirmed that ESC,
newline/forged framing, and carriage return in supplied pane text survive the
human output.

The demonstrated pane source requires an authenticated same-user registration.
No external-input path to that pane was established. C33 trusts same-user
processes, so this demonstration is not a blocking security vulnerability.
The newly exposed paths are TS state text and non-FYI send warnings; held-FYI
warnings already printed. In `crates/cli/src/main.rs:4251-4255`, the added Rust
label uses daemon-generated armed/unarmed values, while the warning print was
already present before this PR.

Optional hardening: restrict pane identifiers to their closed grammar or
visibly escape controls in a single-line human representation. Existing new
tests cover benign wording, not hostile terminal-control text. This is not a
merge gate under C33/C34.

- `just pr-freeze 287` initially passed, confirming the requested head, clean
  detached worktree, main base, and successful latest CI checks.
- CI run `44718113663` is bound to the requested head. Node 22/24 typecheck,
  lint, and test jobs passed. Node 22 job `136226590540` ran
  `generation-routing.test.ts`: 57 tests passed; suite totals were 2368 passed
  and 7 skipped. Rust job `136226589927` reported 2648 passed, 6 skipped;
  Rust lint also passed.
- `just --no-dotenv --command harness/scripts/nice19.sh node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --input-type=module` with inline
  exact-source renderer assertions passed (exit 0). It used only Node builtins,
  did not load project dependencies, and preserved benign armed/no-warning
  output while confirming raw controls survive.
- `harness boot` returned advisory `ready: false`: local vitest is missing.
  `just worktree-deps --check` exited 1. No dependencies were installed or linked.
- `harness checks --quick` exited 1 due to missing local TS tooling and an

- The final `just pr-freeze 287` invocation failed because the PR moved to the

Cost: rendering only; no added loop, poll, timer, request, or process launch.
No steady-state per-seat cost change. Security/287 holding is retained until
